newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX confirms in talks with IPE on trading hours.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX confirms in talks with IPE on trading hours.

text.p: A Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) official confirmed on Tuesday that discussions were being held with London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) over trading hours.
The official, however, said he wanted to clarify that the talks were part of discussions taking place between the two exchanges on a range of issues.
Earlier, an IPE spokeswoman said IPE wanted to bring forward its trading hours to its original 0930 GMT from the current 1000 GMT.
It changed its hours on signing a five-year mutual offset agreement in 1995 allowing SIMEX to trade Brent.
The spokeswoman said the IPE estimated it had lost 1,500 lots of Brent business in the half hour period, while SIMEX generally trades only a handful of lots during it.
